 Order

This is first bail application filed by the applicant under section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.84/2023 dated 06.03.2023 registered at Police Station Bamitha., District Chhatarpur (M.P) for the offences punishable under Sections 304(B) and 498A of IPC and Sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the crime in question.
The applicant is in custody since 13.04.2023 and trial will take considerable time to conclude.
Applicant is permanent resident of District Chhatarpur and he is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by all the conditions to be imposed by the Court.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
According to prosecution, Rajkumari committed suicide within 7 years of her marriage because she was being harassed on account of dowry demand.
The incident of suicide is dated 16.02.2023, while the statements of relatives of deceased were recorded on 06.03.2023 and there is no explanation for delay.
FIR suggests that one Rajabai informed about the commission of suicide but her statements are also not available in the case diary.
Statements of independent witnesses are also not available on the point of demand of dowry and harassment.

Looking to the facts and circumstances, without commenting any opinion on the merits of this case,
the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.
It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.

(ANURADHA SHUKLA) JUDGE DevS Pooran @ Pushpendra Kushwaha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86333092/
